text: The club's partner page for J.Bervas Automobiles (business.sb29.bzh/partenaire/sofipel/) gives 175 rue de Gouesnou, Brest. The company register lists SOFIPEL (SIREN 440978062, SAS) at angle Bd de l'Europe / 175 rue de Gouesnou, Brest, with Marc Yvon Philippe Trébaol-Pelleau as Président de SAS.
short: The club's J.Bervas Automobiles partner page and the company SOFIPEL share a Brest address.
